newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end lower on late hedge selling.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end lower on late hedge selling.

text.p: *JGB futures ended easier on large volume of late selling, which many said reflected trader interest in hedging against new purchases of four-year JGBs. *Auction of 400 billion yen of 1.4 pct 4-year JGBs produced lowest price of 100.04 and average of 100.07. *Market awaits industrial output data on Wednesday.
